name: Turkish to Turkish Sign Language Configuration
description: Configuration for Turkish (Türkçe) spoken language to Turkish Sign Language (Türk İşaret Dili - TİD) translation pipeline

spoken.name: Turkish
spoken.notes: Turkish is an agglutinative language with rich morphology. The simple glosser uses simplemma for lemmatization.

signed.name: Turkish Sign Language
signed.notes: TİD is the sign language used by the Deaf community in Turkey. Real pose data is required for translation.

text_to_gloss.notes: Turkish text can be processed and lemmatized using the simple glosser with simplemma.

gloss_to_pose.notes: Requires a real TİD lexicon with pose files. No lexicon is included in this repository.
required_data: index.csv mapping Turkish words to TİD signs

pose_to_video.notes: Depends on gloss_to_pose. Will work once a TİD lexicon is provided.

turkish_spoken.script: Latin alphabet with Turkish-specific characters (ç, ğ, ı, i, İ, ö, ş, ü)

tid_signed.grammar: TİD has its own grammatical structure distinct from Turkish
tid_signed.word_order: Different from Turkish, may vary with context
tid_signed.space: Uses signing space for grammatical purposes
tid_signed.non_manual_markers: Facial expressions and head movements are grammatically significant
tid_signed.regional_variation: May have regional dialects across Turkey

simple_sentences.english: I am learning Turkish Sign Language

external_resources.name: İşaret Dili - Turkish Sign Language Association
external_resources.description: Turkish Sign Language resources and advocacy

external_resources.name: Boğaziçi University Sign Language Research
external_resources.description: Academic research on Turkish Sign Language

ethical_considerations: Comply with data protection regulations (KVKK in Turkey)

current_limitations: No TİD lexicon included in repository
Gloss-to-pose translation not available without lexicon
Advanced glossers (rules, nmt) not configured for Turkish/TİD
future_work: Collaborate with Turkish Deaf community to create TİD lexicon
Train NMT model for Turkish to TİD gloss translation
Research and implement TİD word order rules
Add support for regional TİD variants
Integrate non-manual markers in pose generation

contact.note: If you have access to TİD data or want to contribute to Turkish Sign Language support, please open an issue on GitHub.
contact.contribution_guidelines: See docs/TURKISH_TID_SUPPORT.md for guidelines on contributing TİD data
